QuestInfo.name: Weirdness in Henesys
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p1012003# in #m100000000#. He surely has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012003# wants to spread word about what happened in #m100000000# and is asking for your help.\r\nGet some advice from #b#p1012111##k in #b#m100040000##k before you leave.

0.0: Evan, I have one more request. I'm concerned that what happened in #m100000000# may be happening in other areas.
0.1: I want to spread the word about what happened here... Oh, and before you go, talk to #b#p1012111##k. He'll have some evidence for you to present to other towns.

yes.0: #b#p1012111##k is studying Golems in #b#m100040000##k. He'll tell you what to bring and who to show.
yes.1: Say, that lizard you have next to you... Is it friendly? And shouldn't it have a collar on? It's rather... big... for a pet.

no.0: Is this request too much for you? But, you saved #p1012108#! This is the easy part.

1.0: Hm? Hey, Evan. What's up? Can I help you with anything? \r\n#L0##b(Tell him about #p1012003#'s request.)#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, that Chief Stan. Always trying to warn other villages about the problems in #m100000000#.

yes.0: It's true the Golems have been acting strange lately. Let me check my notes.

npc.0: Why aren't you talking to #b#p1012111##k yet? He'll be in #b#m100040000##k.
